basic_info.chief_complaint: Movable teeth have fallen out and cannot chew

chief_complaint.chief_complaint: Movable teeth have fallen out and cannot chew

present_illness.present_illness: The full-mouth removable denture was repaired more than 20 years ago. Now the denture cannot be retained, the mandibular mucosa is swollen and painful, and I cannot chew. I came to our hospital for treatment.
present_illness.past_history: He denies a history of systemic diseases, family history, drug allergies, dental treatment, and a history of traveling to medium- and high-risk areas within 14 days. He denied "fever, dry cough, fatigue, loss of smell and taste, nasal congestion, runny nose, sore throat, conjunctivitis, myalgia and diarrhea" and other symptoms related to COVID-19. Body temperature 36.2C.

oral_examination.oral_examination: Full mouth plastic base removable denture repair, the base is seriously aged, the mandibular denture base is broken, the tooth particles are severely worn, mucosal ulcers can be seen in the extension area of ​​the base, the alveolar bone is severely absorbed, the height is insufficient, and the alveolar ridge in the maxillary anterior teeth area is The alveolar roof on the right side of the mandible is absorbed to about the level of the mucosal turning point, and the alveolar crest mucosa is soft. 8 The alveolar bone is severely resorbed, the highest point of the maxillary alveolar bone is about 8-10mm, and the distance between the highest point of the mandibular alveolar bone and the neural tube is\nAbout 6mm

source_handle: Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Get the stored model and design a removable denture. If the removable denture cannot be repaired, refer to the implantology department for consultation.
